sources_tried: Seed file mesa.json (Maps and web results): worked. 8 plausible sites opened. Division Nine Contracting (plaster/EIFS, no partitions) and MAS Sales (plumbing rep, no partitions) excluded. The rest of the Maps hits were residential remodelers, plumbers or stores.
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): page loaded, but the rep dropdown didn't render, so no AZ reps came back.
Scranton Products: /find-a-rep/ returned 404. /where-to-buy/ worked but lists only a factory product specialist for AZ (John McKeon), not a local installer.
ASI / Global Partitions (globalpartitions.com/where-to-buy): host unreachable from this session's network (ENOTFOUND). The host must be allowed in the session's network settings.
Bradley find-a-rep: page loaded with no rep content.
Metpar representatives: 404. General Partitions and Ampco not tried.

The Blue Book (thebluebook.com iProView pages): blocked with 403. Search snippets mentioned Millennium Designs/TENCO (Division 10, serving Phoenix/Mesa) and Partition Plus Inc (Maryland). They weren't verified and aren't included.

WebSearch: all 8 searches used. Queries covered toilet partition installation Mesa/Phoenix, Division 10 contractor Phoenix, restroom partitions installer Tempe/Chandler/Scottsdale, Millennium Designs TENCO, ROC partitions Phoenix, Partition Plus/Allegheny, BBB/Yelp Phoenix/Gilbert/Glendale and furnish-and-install AZ. They surfaced Inter-Co, Black Scale (via the seed), One Point Partitions and BBB category pages.

BBB partition category pages (Mesa, Phoenix, Oro Valley): worked. The listed firms are mostly drywall contractors, Hufcor (operable walls) and Statewide Installations (office furniture). None were confirmed for toilet partitions, so none were added.
Yelp: no Yelp results came up in search.
One Point Partitions (onepointpartitions.com): 403. Search snippets describe it as an online seller with Phoenix delivery terminals and self-install videos, so it was excluded.

Innergy Interiors (innergy-interiors.pages.dev): read. It furnishes and installs Division 10 including toilet compartments and lists AZROC #355389, but it is based in El Paso, TX, beyond the 120-mile limit, so it was excluded.
Allegheny Construction Specialties (Phoenix job posting): the host was unreachable (job-openings.youthopps.monster.com, ENOTFOUND) and no company site was found, so it isn't included.
City of Phoenix solicitation 2041: read. No restroom partition award or vendors were listed.
